sample_reason.selection: known development outcomes, not a random or unseen cohort
sample_reason.sample_1025: r=0.25 matched random noise induced-failure rate was 28/32 in the v9c diagnostic; 1025 cannot decide the conclusion alone

attack_tie_break: smaller native L_attack, then earlier step
compensation_tie_break: smaller native L_attack, then earlier step

losses.L_attack: 0.5 * (m_fastv_0.25 + m_fastv_0.35) via v7d native_grad.fastv_rows soft margins

projection: integer Euclidean projection onto the component and sum L-infinity intersection; phase 2 freezes delta_attack

decision_thresholds.GO_ATTACK_COMPENSATION_STRUCTURE: at least 2/6 strong and at least 3/6 strong or partial, witnesses not all from 1025, no integrity divergence
decision_thresholds.PARTIAL_ATTACK_COMPENSATION_STRUCTURE: fewer than 2/6 strong, at least 2/6 strong or partial, no integrity divergence
decision_thresholds.NO_GO_ATTACK_COMPENSATION_STRUCTURE: fewer than 2/6 strong or partial, or compensation usually repairs FastV as well as Full, or compensation-only is the main attack, or every witness is 1025
decision_thresholds.BASELINE_OR_REPLAY_DIVERGED: any baseline, prompt, token, K, keep-set, or disk-replay mismatch
